title: A Cohort Study on Biomarkers of Hypertension in Guangdong Province(GDP Study)
brief_summary: Hypertension is the most common chronic diseases and a most important risk factor for cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, and also a substantial public health problem. The purpose of the study is to investigate the association between biomarkers and adverse outcomes in patients with hypertension.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥18 years old
* In accordance with the diagnosis of hypertension (including Blood pressure ≥140/90mmHg and/or taking antihypertensive drugs and/or self-reported hypertension)

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<18 years old
* Unsigned informed consent
* Pregnant Women and Lactation
